name: Strix Security Scan
description: Run Strix autonomous AI penetration tests from a dedicated panel and browse the findings. Desktop only — requires a local Docker daemon and the strix CLI on PATH.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Shells out to the strix CLI and drives a local Docker daemon — desktop only.

mobile.reason: Requires a local Docker daemon and the strix CLI — unavailable on mobile.

commands.name: /security
commands.description: Open the Strix security scanner panel.

en.manifest.name: Strix Security Scan
en.manifest.description: Run Strix autonomous AI penetration tests from a dedicated panel and browse the findings. Desktop only — requires a local Docker daemon and the strix CLI on PATH.
en.panel.title: Security
en.preflight.dockerMissing: Docker daemon is not reachable. Start Docker, then re-check.
en.preflight.strixMissing: The strix CLI was not found on your PATH.
en.preflight.install: Install Strix with `pipx install strix-agent`, start Docker, then re-check.
en.form.modelPlaceholder: e.g. openai/gpt-5 — blank uses your shell STRIX_LLM
en.form.authLabel: I am authorized to run a penetration test against this target.
en.form.authWarning: Strix actively attacks the target. Only scan systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test — unauthorized testing may be illegal.
en.console.title: Output
en.console.truncated: Earlier output was dropped — showing the most recent output only.
en.run.scanning: Scanning {target} — findings appear when it finishes.
en.triage.label: Verdict
en.history.title: Scan history
en.history.deleteRunningDisabled: Stop the scan before deleting it
en.confirm.deleteRun.title: Delete this scan?
en.confirm.deleteRun.message: Removes the run for {target}, its findings, and its on-disk report — including any proof-of-concept exploits. This cannot be undone.
en.confirm.clearAll.title: Clear all scans?
en.confirm.clearAll.message: Deletes all {count} runs, their findings, every triage decision, and every on-disk report. This cannot be undone.
en.panel.unavailable.runtime: The Security panel is not connected to the plugin runtime. Disable and re-enable the plugin, then reopen this panel.
en.panel.unavailable.storage: Plugin storage is unavailable in this shell, so scans cannot be recorded and are disabled here.
en.run.error.setupFailed: Could not prepare the scan directory (exit {exit}).
en.run.error.reportUnreadable: Strix produced a vulnerability report that could not be parsed ({detail}). Treat this run as INCONCLUSIVE, not as zero findings.
en.run.error.interrupted: Scan was interrupted — the host was closed or the plugin was reloaded before it finished.
en.error.actionFailed: That change could not be saved: {message}
en.commands.security.description: Open the Strix security scanner panel.

zh-CN.manifest.name: Strix 安全扫描
zh-CN.manifest.description: 在专用面板中运行 Strix 自主 AI 渗透测试并浏览发现的问题。仅限桌面端——需要本地 Docker 守护进程和 PATH 中的 strix CLI。
zh-CN.panel.title: 安全扫描
zh-CN.preflight.ready: Docker 与 strix 已就绪。
zh-CN.preflight.dockerMissing: 无法连接 Docker 守护进程。请启动 Docker 后重新检查。
zh-CN.preflight.strixMissing: 未在 PATH 中找到 strix 命令行工具。
zh-CN.preflight.install: 用 `pipx install strix-agent` 安装 Strix，并启动 Docker，然后重新检查。
zh-CN.form.modelPlaceholder: 如 openai/gpt-5 — 留空则用 shell 的 STRIX_LLM
zh-CN.form.apiKeyLabel: API key 覆盖（可选，不保存）
zh-CN.form.apiKeyPlaceholder: 仅本次扫描使用的 LLM_API_KEY
zh-CN.form.authLabel: 我已获授权对该目标进行渗透测试。
zh-CN.form.authWarning: Strix 会主动攻击目标。仅可扫描你拥有或已获明确授权的系统——未授权测试可能违法。
zh-CN.console.title: 输出
zh-CN.console.empty: 扫描输出将在此处实时显示。
zh-CN.console.truncated: 较早的输出已被丢弃——仅显示最新输出。
zh-CN.run.scanning: 正在扫描 {target}——完成后将显示漏洞。
zh-CN.triage.label: 处置
zh-CN.history.title: 扫描历史
zh-CN.confirm.deleteRun.title: 删除该次扫描？
zh-CN.confirm.deleteRun.message: 将删除 {target} 的扫描记录、漏洞及其磁盘报告（含复现脚本），不可撤销。
zh-CN.confirm.clearAll.title: 清除全部扫描？
zh-CN.confirm.clearAll.message: 将删除全部 {count} 条扫描记录、所有漏洞、全部处置决定及磁盘报告，不可撤销。
zh-CN.panel.unavailable.runtime: 安全面板没有连接到插件运行时。请停用后重新启用插件，再打开这个面板。
zh-CN.panel.unavailable.storage: 当前环境无法使用插件存储，扫描记录无法保存，因此这里禁用了扫描。
zh-CN.run.error.setupFailed: 无法准备扫描目录（退出码 {exit}）。
zh-CN.run.error.reportUnreadable: Strix 生成了无法解析的漏洞报告（{detail}）。请把这次运行视为“无法判定”，而不是“零发现”。
zh-CN.run.error.strixError: Strix 报告了错误（退出码 {exit}）。
zh-CN.run.error.interrupted: 扫描被中断——在它完成之前，宿主已关闭或插件被重新加载。
zh-CN.commands.security.description: 打开 Strix 安全扫描面板。
